steps.objective: 完成「PETSc CG：架構、所有權與資料介面」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for PETSc CG: architecture,ownership and data interfaces and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付Ax/r/誤差表、停止判準與獨立殘差重算。
在交接件中加入「PETSc CG：架構、所有權與資料介面」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：首案Ax[1.8,4]、r[.2,0]，||b||=sqrt20；誤差範數.1是另一量；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：列Ax、r=b−Ax和精確解[1,1]，分別畫殘差與解誤差兩欄；兩比值正確，第一案不過.01、第二案通過；明示這是教學門檻。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver Ax/residual/error tables, stopping rules and independent residual checks.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for PETSc CG: architecture,ownership and data interfaces: First Ax [1.8, 4], r [.2, 0], ||b||sqrt 20; solution-error norm 0.1 is separate. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: List Ax, r = b − Ax, and the exact solution [1, 1]. Keep residual and solution-error columns separate. Both ratios match; first fails 0.01, second passes, and the threshold is labeled instructional. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。首案Ax[1.8,4]、r[.2,0]，||b||=sqrt20；誤差範數.1是另一量；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. First Ax [1.8, 4], r [.2, 0], ||b||sqrt 20; solution-error norm 0.1 is separate. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 首案Ax[1.8,4]、r[.2,0]，||b||=sqrt20；誤差範數.1是另一量；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
steps.checkEn: First Ax [1.8, 4], r [.2, 0], ||b||sqrt 20; solution-error norm 0.1 is separate. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: PETSc KSP提供迭代解法與收斂檢查；本課分清殘差小與解誤差小不是同一量。
knowledge.textEn: PETSc KSP provides iterative solvers/convergence checks; a small residual differs from a small solution error.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 列Ax、r=b−Ax和精確解[1,1]，分別畫殘差與解誤差兩欄；兩比值正確，第一案不過.01、第二案通過；明示這是教學門檻。
knowledge.textEn: List Ax, r = b − Ax, and the exact solution [1, 1]. Keep residual and solution-error columns separate. Both ratios match; first fails 0.01, second passes, and the threshold is labeled instructional.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 相對殘差ρ=||b−Ax||₂/||b||₂；CG另需適合的對稱正定問題，不能忽略矩陣條件。
knowledge.textEn: Relative residual rho=||b−Ax||₂/||b||₂; CG also requires suitable symmetric-positive-definite systems.
